name: stijnVanHorenbeek-pi-ste-writing
description: A Pi-native skill for human-facing technical prose. It improves clarity without changing technical meaning. The package adapts useful ASD-STE100 practices for software documentation. It does not make normal Pi coding conversations conform to strict Simplified Technical English (STE).
